inlines.v: COMFORTABLEY, adverb 1. In a manner to give comfort or consolation. Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem. Isaiah 40:2. 2. With comfort, or cheerfulness; without despair. Hope comfortably and cheerfully for Gods performance.
